mapper.select: select a.*, c.name as category_name, u.real_name as organizer_name, r.status as reg_status, (select count(*) from activity_registration x where x.activity_id = a.id and x.status in (1, 2, 4)) as joined_count, (select count(*) from activity_registration x where x.activity_id = a.id and x.status = 2) as checkin_count, (select count(*) from activity_registration x where x.activity_id = a.id and x.status = 4) as absent_count, (select count(*) from activity_registration x where x.activity_id = a.id and x.status = 3) as cancel_count, (select avg(x.score) from activity_review x where x.activity_id = a.id) as avg_score, (select count(*) from activity_review x where x.activity_id = a.id) as review_count from activity a left join activity_category c on c.id = a.category_id left join sys_user u on u.id = a.organizer_id left join activity_registration r on r.activity_id = a.id and r.user_id = #{userId} where a.id = #{id}
